snippet.title: Nintendo 64 Longplay [072] Resident Evil 2 (Part 1 of 4) Claire A
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Spazbo4

The biggest difference between this version and any other version of Resident Evil 2 is that the audio quality is completely terrible and the CG cutscenes are super compressed trying to compress everything into a 64MB cartridge. It also has extra files that are in the game that tie it to the first Resident Evil and upcoming Resident Evil Zero that was going to originally have an N64 release

For the Claire B run I died at one point and since I didn't save I had to go all the way back to the beginning, since I was so far ahead I just stitched a second try after the part of me dying but I did use the Infinite Rocket Launcher from that point forward. Also in the Claire B video I have the 4th Survivor and Tofu Survivor Levels shown at the end -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
